description:
FILED s543f (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-21), found by member 1's probe table (PPI batch 11, a `/x/` after `and` / `or` / `not` in a list -- the tokens are right; the lowering is not).

A low-precedence `and` / `or` whose operand is a COMMA LIST, inside a list:

    my $x = (1 and 2, 0); print "$x\n";
      perl: 0            PCL: ARRAY(0x1)
    my @r = ((1 and 2, 0) or (3, 4)); print "@r\n";
      perl: 3 4          PCL: 2 0
    $_ = "x"; my @r = (1 and /x/, 0 or /x/, not /y/); print "@r\n";
      perl: 1 1          PCL: 1 0

perl: `and` / `or` bind looser than the comma, so `1 and 2, 0` is `1 and (2, 0)`; the LEFT operand of `or` is evaluated in BOOLEAN (scalar) context -- `(2, 0)` there is the comma operator, 0 -- and the result of `and` in scalar context is its right operand's scalar value (0).  PCL evaluates the comma list in list context (an array object stringifies as ARRAY(0x1); `or` sees a true list).  Same on main ffc7eb72 (tree = base).

Probe file: scratch/s543f/andor.pl in the s543f worktree (agent-a64e9ad186336c772).
BAR: the three rows vs perl, plus `(0 or 3, 4)` (perl 3 4, right today) and `my $y = (0 or 3, 4)` as controls; corpus-diff; a guard row.

NOTE (s543f, same day): the `ARRAY(0x1)` face may share its cause with #1039 (an array in STRING context is `ARRAY(0x1)`), which s543e (IDs 5210-5229) is fixing -- re-run the three rows on main after s543e merges before working on this.


=== DONE (s543j, Opus 5.5, 2026-11-22; WIP 7 f97ce3a0) ===
Re-run on b58114ca: all three rows still wrong (not #1039's).  The parse tree was RIGHT (`and(1, comma(2, 0))`); the right operand kept the stale LIST annotation of the paren list's kid after #611's push-down made the operator SCALAR.  ExprToCL::gen_binary_op_form: `&& || // and or` re-derive the RIGHT operand's context from the operator's emit-time (raw) context, exactly as gen_ternary does for its branches.  Members 6 and 7 share the RULE (an emit-time context reaches an inheriting child), not the code.  Probes the s543j worktree (agent-abcd8b98eb856dbee) scratch/s543j/probes/m7 (10): base 8, tree 10 = perl (incl. `open(...) or die "x", 1`, call args, an anon array, `not 1, 2`, `1 xor 0, 1`).  Guard Pl/t/list-scalar-context-01.t #5230 row (inverse ok).
